candidates.old:
LDY mover
    LDX plot_sprite
    LDA sprite_column_count,X       \ (bank 4, which plot_mover pages in)
    CLC
    ADC movers_x_low,Y              \ less the columns clipped at the left:
    CLC                             \ (C = 0: one more taken off)
    SBC mover_x_low                 \ count - (mover_x_low - movers_x_low) - 1
    TAX                             \ n - 1 (n: columns from here)
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC mover_x_low
    STA walk_d                      \ d (low bytes, as the plotter compares them)
    CPX walk_d
    BCC moved_on                    \ n - 1 < d: the common case
    CLC                             \ (Z kept)
    BEQ moved_on                    \ n - 1 = d: the same sums
    LDA viewport_right_low          \ n - 1 > d: mover_x_low + d...
    STA mover_x_low
    LDA pixel_table_address_low     \ ...and d + 1 steps (d < 255 here),
    BNE walk_beyond_steps
    INX                             \ but none if flipped with n = 0
    BEQ walked
.walk_beyond_steps
    LDX walk_d
    INX
    BNE steps_known                 \ always
.moved_on
    TXA                             \ C = 0
candidates.new:
LDY mover
    LDX plot_sprite
    LDA viewport_right_low
    SEC
    SBC mover_x_low
    STA walk_d                      \ d (low bytes, as the plotter compares them)
    LDA sprite_column_count,X       \ (bank 4, which plot_mover pages in)
    CLC
    ADC movers_x_low,Y              \ less the columns clipped at the left:
    CLC                             \ (C = 0: one more taken off)
    SBC mover_x_low                 \ count - (mover_x_low - movers_x_low) - 1
    TAX                             \ n - 1 (n: columns from here), kept in A too
    CMP walk_d                      \ A = X = n - 1 against d
    BCC moved_on                    \ n - 1 < d: the common case
    CLC                             \ (Z kept)
    BEQ moved_on                    \ n - 1 = d: the same sums
    LDA viewport_right_low          \ n - 1 > d: mover_x_low + d...
    STA mover_x_low
    LDA pixel_table_address_low     \ ...and d + 1 steps (d < 255 here),
    BNE walk_beyond_steps
    INX                             \ but none if flipped with n = 0
    BEQ walked
.walk_beyond_steps
    LDX walk_d
    INX
    BNE steps_known                 \ always
    SKIP 1                          \ never run: keeps moved_on's ADC and everything after where they were
.moved_on
    \ A = n - 1 (CMP's operand), C = 0 on both entries
candidates.summary: walk_column: d is computed and stored first, then n - 1 into A (and X by TAX) so CMP walk_d leaves A = n - 1 for moved_on, which drops its TXA (2 cycles on the hot path); a never-run SKIP 1 before .moved_on keeps the ADC and all later code at their old addresses. Alternative to the next candidate (they overlap).
candidates.equivalence: Same instructions in a different order, less moved_on's TXA. d = viewport_right_low - mover_x_low and walk_d are stored before n - 1 is computed; they read only zero-page bytes/tables that nothing in between writes (walk_d &9D is distinct from mover_x_low &F8, viewport_right_low &B3), so values are unchanged. n - 1 ends in A and X; CMP walk_d with A = n - 1 gives the same C and Z as CPX walk_d with X = n - 1 (CPX/CMP set N, Z, C identically; N/V not read by BCC/BEQ). BCC moved_on: C = 0, A = X = n - 1, exactly what TXA produced. n - 1 > d path (C=1, Z=0): BEQ not taken, CLC changes nothing, A is overwritten by LDA viewport_right_low as before and X carries n - 1 as before. n - 1 = d: CLC leaves A, so BEQ moved_on enters with A = X = n - 1, C = 0 (as before after TXA). Exit state unchanged: A,X,Y as before at steps_known (the first live use of A there is TXA), A on the moved_on path = n - 1 then ADC/STA as before. The only registers differing on entry to the ADC: none (A = X before and after). Flags N/V at moved_on are overwritten by ADC. Y is untouched throughout (LDY mover first). No interrupt use of any of these bytes (walk_d zero-page scratch, per the source comment).
candidates.relies_on: moved_on is reached only from the BCC and BEQ above (grep: no other reference; no walk_column + n entries; JSR walk_column is the only entry). A = X = n - 1 at both entries (TAX then CMP/CLC leave A alone). No page-crossing change: every instruction before .moved_on keeps its length, SKIP 1 sits in the unreachable byte after the always-taken BNE steps_known and the dropped TXA is replaced by that byte, so moved_on's ADC and every later address (steps_known, walked, get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses and on) are identical to the control's. BCC moved_on moves from target &1B3A to &1B3B (same page &1B, taken branch cost unchanged). Needs 1 byte of the main block unchanged in size: no room risk.

candidates.summary: Same change without the padding byte: 1 byte smaller, but walked, get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses and the code after slide down 1 byte. Alternative to the previous candidate (they overlap).
candidates.equivalence: As the previous candidate: identical logic, TXA at moved_on dropped because A = X = n - 1 already (TAX, then CMP walk_d does not alter A).
candidates.relies_on: Moves everything from moved_on's ADC on 1 byte earlier (control: moved_on &1B3A, steps_known &1B44, walked &1B62, get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses &1B63 in the bench build): the hot BCC c1_walk_high_kept/BNE steps_known/BCC moved_on branches and the walk's internal ones stay in page &1B; the code from &1B63 to the next page boundary &1C00 (get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses, the clip loops' branches and any indexed read in it) slides one byte, which could change which taken branches cross into &1C; not counted per branch, only the gate can say. Prefer the padded candidate unless the gate shows a gain from the slide.
